project_type: 4A Store v2 monorepo: Express+Prisma+MySQL API (api-node), React+Vite storefront+admin (web), Expo SDK 54 + expo-router app (mobile). POS/inventory is a NEW in-store counter subsystem added alongside the existing online-order flow, sharing the one four_a_store MariaDB/MySQL DB and the one api-node backend.
language: TypeScript (Node 20 backend, React 18 web, React Native 0.81 / React 19 mobile)
build_system: api-node: tsc (npm run build). web: vite 5 + tsc -b + a sitemap script (npm run build). mobile: Expo, tsc --noEmit (npm run typecheck). QUIRK: the worktree has NO node_modules in any of the three projects — each must `npm install` before its first build. QUIRK: `prisma generate` may 403 on the engine CDN; new prisma.<model> delegate-missing tsc errors are EXPECTED pre-deploy and are NOT a regression.
test_framework: mobile has a Node built-in test runner (npm test = node --test over src/__tests__/**/*.test.ts). api-node has NO test runner today — add a minimal node:test setup for pure-function + leakage tests. web has no test runner.
build_command: api-node: npm --prefix c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\pos-billing\4astore-v2\api-node run build  |  web: npm --prefix ...\web run build  |  mobile: npm --prefix ...\mobile run typecheck
test_command: mobile: npm --prefix ...\mobile test  |  api-node: node --test (new harness)
verification_instructions: Per increment: (1) api-node `npm run build` — tolerable ONLY new prisma.<posModel> delegate errors; ANY other new tsc error is a regression and must be fixed. (2) web `npm run build` MUST exit 0. (3) mobile `npm run typecheck` clean for touched files; `npm test` for shared pure logic. For idempotent/transactional billing (acceptance d): write+run a focused test proving a retried/duplicated checkout deducts stock exactly once and cancel restores it; if the DB is unreachable, write the test, state it needs the deploy DB, and prove idempotency via a precise transaction + idempotency-key code walkthrough in the test file.
snapshot_or_generated_files: web build runs scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs (writes public/sitemap.xml) as part of `npm run build` — expected, not a stray edit. No other generated files are checked in by the POS work. Prisma client is NOT generated in the worktree and must not be forced.
environment_constraints: cwd is the PARENT session workspace, NOT the worktree — ALWAYS use absolute paths under c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\pos-billing and `git -C c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\pos-billing`. NEVER prisma migrate / db push / (forced) generate. NO native build: no AAB, no expo prebuild, no gradle; leave mobile/app.config.ts versionCode ALONE. Commit locally on branch `pos-billing`; NEVER push.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING at repo root. Conventions are enforced by the existing code: additive schema only via information_schema-guarded raw-SQL ensure*() in services/dataImport.ts (swallow MySQL 1060), mirrored by a Prisma model carrying the runtime-created comment, plus a manual prisma/*.sql. Money DECIMAL(10,2)/aggregates (12,2); quantity DECIMAL(10,3); integer-paise math, never floats. Protect every admin/POS API server-side with requireAuth + requireStaff(permission)/requireOwner. Do NOT break online orders/checkout/catalog/SEO/short-links/marketing.
key_patterns: ensure* pattern: ensureMasterPasswordColumn (information_schema COUNT guard + swallow 1060), ensureMarketingTables / ensureShortLinkTables (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS via $executeRawUnsafe, InnoDB utf8mb4, mirrored Prisma model + manual .sql). Startup wiring: server.ts app.listen callback calls each ensure* fire-and-forget `.catch(console.error)` after seedDefaultOwner/ensureMarketingTables. RBAC: auth/middleware.ts requireAuth, requireOwner (role==='owner'), requireStaff(permission) (STAFF_ROLES owner/superadmin/admin + hasPermission: owner/superadmin short-circuit, admin checks permissions includes '*' or key). Session helpers issueTokens/safeUser/toClaims/isMobileClient are MODULE-PRIVATE in routes/users.ts (must be extracted to auth/session.ts for pos-auth to reuse). Push: services/push.ts exports sendToTokens, tokensForStaff(permission), recordNotification, PushMessage. OTP: routes/otp.ts stores 6-digit codes in emailOtp with purpose + devOtp in non-prod. Admin perms list: ALLOWED_PERMS in routes/admin.ts. Web admin nav: ADMIN_TABS array + canAdmin(role,perms,key) filter in pages/admin/AdminApp.tsx. Mobile admin screens: app/admin/orders.tsx guard pattern (canAdmin + router.replace('/login')). Invoice: web/src/lib/invoice.ts uses jsPDF core with `const rupee='Rs. '` (CANNOT render ₹/Devanagari/emoji) — DO NOT touch it for online orders; mobile/src/invoice.ts renders HTML via expo-print with Noto Sans and prints ₹ directly (reuse this path).
